global: A rich, golden miso ramen broth fills a black bowl, topped with tender chashu pork, shredded cabbage, and vibrant green scallions. The warm lighting highlights the glossy broth and neatly arranged toppings against a wooden table.

regions.background: Dark wooden table surface with visible grain patterns and subtle reflections, forming an oval-shaped area around the bowl.
regions.bowl: Black ceramic bowl with glossy finish, smooth curved rim, and subtle speckled texture visible along its inner edge.
regions.soup: Miso ramen broth, rich amber-orange, glossy surface with visible noodles, sesame seeds, and green onion garnish.
regions.meat: Chashu pork: tender, thinly sliced, pinkish-brown meat with visible fat marbling and slight char, resting atop noodles.
